reason: It's free while the school runs the pilot and the teacher already assigns it, so I'll let my child do the 20 minutes with the time limit on, but I won't pay anything until I see the end-of-term re-test. If the gaps don't close in the chapters the school actually examines, I'd rather spend on a tuition teacher and keep the tablet away.
objection: It is 20 more minutes a day on a screen, every day, on top of what I already struggle to limit. A report from a test the same app sets doesn't prove my child will do better in the school's own unit tests and exams.
would_change_my_mind: The end-of-term re-test and my child's actual school exam marks both improving in the gap topics, confirmed by the class teacher at the parent-teacher meeting.
